appName: Al Quran Al Kareem - Al Heekmah Library
search_hint: Search the verses of the Quran
about_app: The "Holy Quran - Hikma Library" app is an integrated application that offers a wide range of features to enhance the experience of reading and learning the Holy Quran, including:
about_app2: Among the most important features of the application :
about_app3:
۞ A modern, easy-to-use interface: A contemporary, intuitive design that makes it easy to navigate and access all features, with a new calendar view and the ability to browse the full yearly calendar.
۞ Adopting the King Fahd Complex edition: The app relies on the King Fahd Complex Mushaf edition, known for its accuracy and reliability.
۞ Interactive, comprehensive reading: A flexible reading experience in either Mushaf-page mode or single-ayah mode, with full interaction with the text.
۞ Advanced listening: Listen to ayahs and surahs with voices of selected reciters, with the feature of showing the current ayahs during playback, plus the ability to listen to each word separately to enhance learning.
۞ Fast search and navigation: Instant search within Qur'an verses with direct jump to the desired surah or page, and smooth navigation between surahs.
۞ Tafsir and Islamic library: Access a collection of tafsir and translations, in addition to an integrated Islamic library that includes Hadith and tafsir books.
۞ Tajweed and its rules: Clear display of tajweed and its rules, with the addition of the Ten Qira'at to broaden understanding of recitation methods.
۞ Advanced linguistic analysis: Display morphology (tasreef) and i'rab for each word, helping deeper understanding of linguistic meanings in the Qur'an.
۞ Similar verses: A dedicated feature to display similar verses to make memorization and review easier.
۞ Reading and memorization management: Add bookmarks for ayahs and pages to return to them anytime.
۞ Reading stop signs: Clarify waqf signs to help users read correctly.
۞ Hisn Al-Muslim adhkar: A complete section for reading adhkar with favorites and quick navigation between sections.
۞ Display customization: Support changing color styles, including dark mode, for a comfortable reading experience.
۞ Downloading and offline use: Download surahs and listen later without an internet connection.

These features make the "Holy Quran - Hikma Library" app an integrated platform combining reading, listening, tafsir, and learning, offering a rich and easy-to-use spiritual and educational experience.

mushafTourIntroDesc: A short tour of the Mushaf page: turning pages, the control buttons, and the ayah options you get by pressing and holding.
mushafTourPageFlipDesc: Swipe right to go to the next page and left to go back, just as the page turns before you now and then returns to where you were.
mushafTourControlsBarDesc: Tap the screen to show or hide the controls. In the top bar: auto scroll, the playback playlist, Khatmah, and the Recitations tab.
mushafTourDisplayModesDesc: This bar switches how the Mushaf is shown: the Mushaf alone, the tafsir beside it, or the tafsir under each ayah, depending on your device.
mushafTourAlwaqfDesc: Tap this handle to open the guide to the stop signs and tajweed rules. You can drag it wherever suits you.
mushafTourSearchDesc: Tap the search field and type a word or part of an ayah to reach its ayahs and surahs.
mushafTourSettingsDesc: The settings button opens the Mushaf settings: diacritics and tajweed, font size, background color, ayah audio and more.
mushafTourSurahIndexDesc: Opens the list of surahs and parts to jump straight to any place in the Mushaf.
mushafTourAudioBarDesc: Play the ayah or pause it, and tap the reciter's name to choose a reciter and download his surahs. Swipe the bar up to see the previous and next buttons.
mushafTourBookmarksDesc: Your bookmark list: the pages and ayahs you saved. Tap any of them to go to it.
mushafTourPageBookmarkDesc: Tap this mark at the top of the page to save the page to your bookmarks or remove it.
mushafTourAyahLongPressDesc: Press and hold any ayah to open its options: tafsir, listening, saving, copying and sharing. Try it now and we will explain what appears.
mushafTourAyahTextDesc: The text of the ayah you chose. Tap any word in it to see its details in the panel below.
mushafTourPlayWordDesc: Plays the pronunciation of the selected word.
mushafTourPlayAyahWordsDesc: Plays the words of the ayah one by one, highlighting the current word.
mushafTourSearchWordDesc: Closes the options and searches for the selected word throughout the Quran.
mushafTourWordInfoDesc: Every word has four sections: the recitations in which it was read, its morphology, its grammar, and its meaning.
mushafTourTafsirDesc: Opens the tafsir of the ayah. From the header you choose the mufassir, switch between the tafsir and the tajweed rules, and copy or share.
mushafTourPlayAyahDesc: Closes the options and starts listening to this ayah alone.
mushafTourPlaySurahDesc: Starts listening from this ayah and continues through its surah.
mushafTourAddAyahBookmarkDesc: Adds the ayah to your bookmarks. Tap it again to remove it.
mushafTourCopyDesc: Copies the ayah text, its surah name and its link to the clipboard.
mushafTourShareDesc: Shares the ayah as text, an image or audio, or shares a group of ayahs together.
mushafTourMutashabihatDesc: Shows the ayahs similar to this one. The number above the button is how many there are.
mushafTourClosingDesc: You can replay this tour any time from Settings.
mushafTourAyahLongPressHint: Press and hold any ayah on the page to continue
mushafTourInteractionHint: Do the action in the app to continue
tasmeeTourIntroDesc: A short tour of the Tasmee mode: choosing the mode, then the buttons of the Tasmee bar at the bottom of the screen.
tasmeeTourModeButtonDesc: Press it to switch between the three Tasmee modes: Recite, Recitation corrector and Quran teacher. The button shows the name of the current mode.
tasmeeTourTeacherReaderDesc: In Quran teacher mode, choose here the reciter whose recitation you listen to before repeating it.
tasmeeTourStartRecordingDesc: Press the mic and recite from the page, then stop the recording when you are done. The app compares your recitation with the Mushaf and shows your result automatically, with tajweed, pronunciation and diacritic errors.
tasmeeTourStatusDesc: Your progress appears here: the words you have completed, the analysis state, the correction model download the first time, and any error message.
tasmeeTourShowWordsDesc: Shows or hides the Mushaf words as you recite, so you can test your memorization without looking at them.
tasmeeTourRetryDesc: Starts the recitation again so you can go over the page once more.
tasmeeTourPagesListDesc: The pages you have finished reciting and their saved results. Press one to see its result.
tasmeeTourSettingsDesc: The settings button opens the Tasmee settings: download or delete the local correction model, correction strictness, and reciting on without the correction sheet.
tasmeeTourClosingDesc: You can replay this tour any time from Settings.
audioTourIntroDesc: Get to know the Audio Mushaf screen: choosing a surah and a reciter, playing the recitation, and downloading it for offline listening.
audioTourSearchDesc: Type a surah's name to jump straight to it without scrolling the list.
audioTourLastListenDesc: Returns you to the last surah you listened to, from the position where you stopped.
audioTourFullScreenButtonDesc: Opens the full recitation screen that follows the ayah and the word as you listen.
audioTourSurahListDesc: Tap a surah to play it right away; the surah being played shows an animated indicator beside it.
audioTourDownloadDesc: Download a full surah to listen to it offline; a cancel button appears while downloading.
audioTourCollapsedPlayerDesc: Drag it up to expand the control panel, or use its quick playback buttons directly.
audioTourReciterPickerDesc: Tap the reciter's name to pick another from the reciters list.
audioTourSeekBarDesc: Tracks the recitation position and shows the download progress while a surah downloads. Drag it to jump to another position.
audioTourBackwardDesc: Moves the recitation five seconds back.
audioTourPreviousSurahDesc: Moves to the previous surah and plays it.
audioTourPlayPauseDesc: Starts the recitation or pauses it, and replays it from the start once it completes.
audioTourNextSurahDesc: Moves to the next surah and plays it.
audioTourForwardDesc: Moves the recitation five seconds ahead.
audioTourRepeatDesc: Replays the surah automatically whenever it ends.
audioTourAyahTrackerDesc: Highlights the current ayah and the word being recited; when the data is unavailable, a surah info card is shown instead.
audioTourReaderRowDesc: Shows the current reciter and the surah being listened to.
audioTourCloseButtonDesc: Returns you to the list screen without stopping the recitation.
audioTourClosingDesc: You can replay this tour any time from Settings.
midadTourIntroDesc: Midad is your smart companion for the Qur'an and its sciences: search semantically through libraries stored on your device, or ask the smart assistant directly.
midadTourModeToggleDesc: Moves you between semantic search, which runs on your device without internet, and the smart assistant, which answers with cited sources and needs an internet connection.
midadTourNewChatDesc: Starts a fresh conversation and clears the screen; your previous conversations stay saved in the history.
midadTourHistoryDesc: A unified log of your questions and research: open it to resume any past conversation or delete it.
midadTourFloatingMenuDesc: Drag it anywhere and open it to manage section downloads: add new sections or remove the ones you no longer need.
midadTourSuggestionChipsDesc: Tap any suggestion to start searching right away, or type your own question in the field below.
midadTourInputFieldDesc: Write your question or topic in any wording, and Midad searches the sections you have enabled.
midadTourSendButtonDesc: Sends your question; results appear grouped by section, each with a button that opens the book at the citation.
midadTourSectionFilterDesc: Enable or disable the sections to search in; each section that is not downloaded shows its size.
midadTourAssistantChipsDesc: Ask about the Qur'an and its sciences in any wording, or tap a suggestion to start the dialogue; the assistant answers citing ayahs, hadiths and sources.
midadTourModelSelectorDesc: Chooses the AI model that answers you, from the providers configured on your device.
midadTourClosingDesc: You can replay this tour any time from Settings.
midadDownloadTourIntroDesc: For on-device semantic search, download Midad's libraries once; the smart assistant, on the other hand, works right away with no downloads.
midadDownloadTourModeToggleDesc: Try the smart assistant now by tapping here — it needs no downloads and works over an internet connection.
midadDownloadTourSharedCardDesc: The base search-model files; downloaded once, before any section.
midadDownloadTourSectionCardDesc: Each section has its own card and size: Tafsir, Hadith, Aqeedah, Fiqh and Seerah. Download what you need, or all of them with one button.
midadDownloadTourLaterHintDesc: If you postpone downloading, you will find these cards in the floating menu inside the screen whenever you need them.
midadDownloadTourClosingDesc: You can replay this tour any time from Settings.
midadAssistantTourIntroDesc: Ask your assistant anything about the Qur'an and its sciences, in any wording; it answers citing ayahs, hadiths and sources. For on-device semantic search, download the sections later.
midadAssistantTourInputFieldDesc: Type your question in any wording; the assistant needs no downloads.
midadAssistantTourSendButtonDesc: Sends your question; the answer streams in with quotations from the sources.
booksTourIntroDesc: A complete Islamic library in your hands: works on tafsir, hadith, aqeedah, fiqh and more. Browse them section by section and download what you read for offline reading.
booksTourSearchFieldDesc: Search across all books at once: type a word or a topic and results appear from your downloaded works.
booksTourSectionsButtonDesc: Shows the section you are browsing; tap it to move between sections (All Books, My Library, Tafsir, Hadith...) with each section's book count beside it.
booksTourBookmarksButtonDesc: Takes you straight to the reading bookmarks you saved inside your books.
booksTourLastReadDesc: Tracks your reading: a book resumes where you left off, with your progress shown for each one.
booksTourSortButtonDesc: Sort this section's books: by the author's death year, or alphabetically by book or author name.
booksTourSectionSearchButtonDesc: Opens a field to search this section's book titles and quickly find your book.
booksTourBookGridDesc: Tap any book to open its page: its description, download button, and table of contents.
booksTourClosingDesc: You can replay this tour any time from Settings.
booksChaptersTourIntroDesc: This is a book's page: meet its author, download it to your device, and jump anywhere in it from its table of contents.
booksChaptersTourSearchButtonDesc: Opens a search inside this book only.
booksChaptersTourDownloadButtonDesc: Downloads the book to your device for offline reading; afterwards it becomes a delete button if you want to reload or free up space.
booksChaptersTourAboutBookDesc: A short introduction to the author and the work; expand it to read it in full.
booksChaptersTourTocEmptyDesc: The chapters and the table of contents appear after downloading; tap the download button above first.
booksChaptersTourTocContentDesc: The book's table of contents: jump to any chapter or volume from one place.
booksChaptersTourClosingDesc: You can replay this tour anytime from the question button on the screen.
booksReaderTourIntroDesc: Read your book simply: swipe to turn pages, and tap the text to show or hide the reading controls.
booksReaderTourBookmarkDesc: Saves the page to your bookmarks; tap it to add or remove the current page.
booksReaderTourChaptersDropdownDesc: Shows the chapter you are in; open it to jump to any other chapter in the book.
booksReaderTourSearchInBookDesc: Search the text of this book and see the results at their places.
booksReaderTourTashkilDesc: Shows and hides the diacritics in the page text.
booksReaderTourFontSizeDesc: Drag the slider to make the reading text larger or smaller, as is comfortable for your eyes.
booksReaderTourBackgroundColorDesc: Opens a color palette to pick the reading background that suits you.
booksReaderTourClosingDesc: The reading bars hide with a tap on the text and come back with another tap, and you can replay this tour anytime from the question button on the screen.
azkarTourIntroDesc: A quick look at the Athkar screen: the tabs, reminders, search, and adhkar sections.
azkarTourTabsDesc: Two tabs: Athkar to browse the sections of Hisn Al-Muslim, and Favorites for the adhkar you saved.
azkarTourAlarmDesc: Manage your morning and evening adhkar reminders here, and add custom reminders at times that suit you.
azkarTourSearchDesc: Search for a dhikr across all the sections; a result takes you to its place inside its section.
azkarTourCategoriesDesc: Pick a section to open its full list of adhkar, from morning to sleep.
azkarTourClosingDesc: You can replay this tour any time from Settings.
azkarItemTourIntroDesc: Every dhikr in the section with its options: font size, sharing, copying, and favorites.
azkarItemTourFontSizeDesc: Change the adhkar font size to whatever comforts your eyes.
azkarItemTourOptionsRowDesc: Share the dhikr as text or an image, copy it, or save it to favorites; the badge shows its repetition count.
azkarItemTourZekrTextDesc: The dhikr text, with its reference and description below.
azkarItemTourClosingDesc: You can replay this tour anytime from the question button on the screen.
homeTourIntroDesc: A quick look at your home screen: its sections, features, and what each button opens.
homeTourNotificationsDesc: Alerts for your reminders and Hijri calendar events; a badge on the bell counts the unread ones.
homeTourSettingsDesc: Tap the button or drag the bar to open the app's full settings list.
homeTourHijriDesc: Today's date in Hijri and Gregorian with the month's progress; tap the card to open the calendar and its events.
homeTourMidadDesc: Your companion for seeking knowledge: tap the card to ask about a verse, tafsir, or aqeedah and fiqh.
homeTourTasmeeModeDesc: Your private tutor for memorization and recitation: it opens the mushaf at your last reading to listen to your recitation and correct it.
homeTourLastReadDesc: Your progress through the mushaf; tap the card to continue reading from the last page you reached.
homeTourQuranDesc: Opens the mushaf directly at the last page you read.
homeTourQuranAudioDesc: Opens the audio mushaf to listen to surahs and ayahs with your preferred reciter.
homeTourDailyAyahDesc: A selected verse with its tafsir from your downloaded tafsir, changing every day.
homeTourDailyZekerDesc: A selected supplication for today from Hisn al-Muslim.
homeTourAzkarDesc: Opens the full adhkar screen with its categories, reminders, and search.
homeTourIslamicLibraryDesc: Opens the Islamic Library: works of tafsir, hadith and more; browse and download what you read for offline reading.
homeTourBooksLastReadDesc: Continues from where you stopped in the last book you opened from the library.
homeTourClosingDesc: You can replay this tour any time from Settings.

midadNote:
The 'Midad' model presents results and information extracted from Islamic books and references, with the ability to navigate to the original source and read the full topic from the associated book.
The model aims to facilitate research and access to Islamic content, and is not intended for issuing fatwas or religious rulings.
For religious matters and fatwas, please refer to qualified scholars.
